violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean pan lids more thoroughly. -Clean inside and outside of microwave.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors in dishwash and mop sink area need more thorough cleaning.

General premises. — --Perimeter walls and roof did not effectively protect establishment from the weather and entry of insects, rodents, and other animals. -Fix gap in bottom corner of back entry door.

Thawing potentially hazardous food. — --Potentially hazardous food was not thawed in an approved manner. Employee used warm water to thaw chicken. Thaw under cold running water or under refrigeration.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Walls in the walk-in cooler have visible insulation showing and are no longer a cleanable surface.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors underneath the fryers and floors in the dry storage need to be cleaned.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. Employees shoes were being stored above single-use items in the dry storage area.
